evaluation.realized_matrix: centered sample covariance of next H DAILY returns, ddof=1
evaluation.gaussian_loss_target: uncentered next-H daily second moment, zero conditional mean
evaluation.gaussian_loss_direction: lower is better; no realized matrix inversion
evaluation.origin_rule: monthly last observed return session, forecast at close; exposures dated<=origin
evaluation.eligibility: same ex-ante universe for every method; complete historical direct-return window, finite PIT exposure and adequate specific history
evaluation.future_missing_rule: skip whole origin+horizon; never reselect stocks using future availability
evaluation.development_rule: future horizon end strictly before holdout_start
evaluation.holdout_rule: origin on/after holdout_start; crossing windows labeled split_boundary
evaluation.overlap: Monthly 21-session windows can overlap; 63-session windows overlap substantially. No IID standard errors or significance claims.
evaluation.portfolio_aggregation: EW and cap-weight reported separately; random portfolios grouped by family rather than dominating a pooled score
evaluation.portfolio_calibration: primary ratio sums zero-mean realized second moments / sums forecast variance; centered-variance ratio also reported
evaluation.portfolio_weight_interpretation: frozen weight vector applied to each daily return (fixed-weight/daily-rebalanced diagnostic), not drifting buy-and-hold wealth
evaluation.minimum_variance: unconstrained fully invested optimum, mixed with EW until configured gross cap; covariance and weights use origin data only
evaluation.matrix_jitter: raw forecast used for matrix errors; stabilized covariance used for Gaussian loss, portfolio variance and minimum-variance weights; recover raw by subtracting recorded jitter*I
evaluation.diagonal_shrinkage: factor covariance fixed diagonal shrink; Ledoit-Wolf intensity estimated from past direct returns only
evaluation.factor_specific_dof_variant: optional fixed per-date n/(n-p) residual scaling; default disabled
evaluation.claims: Historical walk-forward forecast assessment; observational coverage conditioning remains material. No return-alpha or trading-cost claims.

limitations: 2026-11-03 current iShares IVV/IJH/IJR holdings, 100 each, sector-round-robin selection; survivor and retrospective selection bias
static current fund sector labels; not historical GICS
Public revised Yahoo total returns; historical delisting completeness is not established
SEC standardized annual statements and lagged total shares; source gaps remain missing
21/63 daily observations give a noisy, often singular proxy for latent future covariance
Fixed-weight portfolio diagnostics imply daily rebalancing; no trading costs modeled

Parameters fixed before viewing expanded OOS scores. Chronological evaluation conditional on a current survivor-selected cohort, not a pristine prospective holdout. Future windows crossing 2022 are boundary-only. Monthly 21/63-day windows can overlap; no IID significance claims.
